date_note: GMA News published on 25 November (Manila time) and reports the NPC spokesperson's remarks at Tuesday's briefing, 24 November.
geo_basis: country as the source states it (Philippines)
title: Philippines' NPC says 11 government agencies have yet to submit full breach reports
summary: The National Privacy Commission (NPC) said 11 government agencies have yet to submit a full breach report, GMA News reports. NPC spokesperson Jose Amelito Belarmino II said a total of 13 government agencies were reportedly hacked, and that failure to submit the full report was already a violation. PAGCOR and the SEC have submitted theirs; the other agencies were not named in the article.
plain: The Philippine privacy regulator says 11 government agencies that were reportedly hacked have not yet filed full breach reports. Its spokesperson said not filing is already a violation.
exec: The NPC says 11 hacked government agencies still owe full breach reports; its spokesperson called not submitting one a violation.

evidence.quote: NPC spokesperson Jose Amelito Belarmino II said that a total of 13 government agencies were reportedly hacked.
The National Privacy Commission (NPC) said that 11 government agencies have yet to submit a full breach report

validation.note: Only GMA News states the 11-of-13 count and the violation remark; Gulf News (10 Nov) reads only for the earlier NPC confirmation of 10 agencies' notifications. NPC's own page not read.
